title: Financialized SLI Bank & Tranche Recovery Playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: Create a repeatable playbook and implementation spec for a centralized 'SLI Bank'—a financialized error-budget pool that supports tranche-based recovery, cross-team borrowing, and automated repayment rules. The playbook will include policy definitions, dashboard requirements, API/ledger schema for Dedicated and Hosted deployments, rollout steps, and guardrails for abuse prevention.

Background: Teams frequently exhaust per-service error budgets during seasonal traffic spikes or coordinated rollouts. Current ad-hoc handoffs (pager overrides, manual throttles) cause delays and inconsistent remediation. The SLI Bank concept treats unused error budget as a transferrable resource that can be lent to teams in distress under clear repayment and throttle terms. This ticket aligns product, SRE, and console workstreams to standardize behavior across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments.

Scope:
- Definition of tranche types (emergency, runway, experimental) and repayment policies.
- Ledger API payloads (immutable event lines) and minimal retention model for audit.
- Console UX flows for borrowing requests, approvals, and automatic grants.
- Telemetry dashboard specs: per-team bank balance, tranche history, projected runway under current burn.
- Autoscaling and runtime integration: fallback throttles, automatic model variant fallback when bank exhausted.
- Rollout plan with canary (1 internal team), controlled cross-team pilot (3 teams), and org-wide opt-in.

Out of scope: fine-grained billing changes, legal contract language for enterprise SLAs, and KMS/HSM cryptography for ledger signing (follow-up ticket).

Rationale: Treating error budget as a managed resource reduces manual coordination, improves predictability for on-call decisions, and creates a measurable runway to authorize riskier experiments without systemic reliability regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Policy doc describing tranche definitions, borrowing limits, repayment formulas, and abuse mitigation
Console mockups for bank view, borrow/repay flows, and admin override UI reviewed by Design
API spec (ledger/events) reviewed by Engineering and stored in Confluence with example payloads
Dashboard wireframe and query templates in observability (SLO and burn rate) showing bank balances and projected runway
Pilot integration with runtime fallback: when a team borrows emergency tranche, auto-fallback to cheaper model variant under specified latency budget
Runbook for oncall describing decision tree: when to borrow, escalate, repay, or hard throttle
Security review completed for ledger immutability and audit access (if required)
tasks: Draft policy language and numeric examples (owner: PM)
Design console mocks for the bank view and notification flows (owner: Design)
Define ledger event schema and retention (owner: Engineering)
Implement backend endpoints for borrow/repay and admin overrides (owner: Eng: runtime-api)
Create dashboard templates and SLO query snippets for bank balance (owner: Observability)
Pilot with 1 internal service and collect 2 weeks of tranche activity (owner: Eng + SRE)
Runbook and playbook doc published to Confluence with example incident narratives (owner: PM)
Post-pilot retro and decision on org-wide opt-in criteria (owner: PM + Eng)
Create follow-up tickets for billing integration and ledger signing (owner: PM)
comments: 2026-02-13 - Aisha Patel: Kickoff meeting notes added to Confluence. SRE concerned about cross-team chargeback complexity; recommended strict caps and priority ordering.

2026-02-18 - Miguel Ortega: Initial policy draft uploaded. Key decision: emergency tranches are auto-granted up to 5% of service's monthly error budget, repay with 2x mitigation window or scheduled tokenized repayment.
2026-02-22 - Design review (Samira Chen): Console mockups look good; requested an explicit 'expected impact' tooltip and colorblind-safe palette for tranche types. Assigned DES-4022 for assets.
2026-02-25 - Eng comments (Priya Nair): Ledger event schema proposal attached. We should make events append-only and sign with service token; separate follow-up for HSM.
2026-03-01 - SRE pilot signups: Platform-team-alpha agreed to be pilot; Observability will provide additional burn-rate alerts. Added ENG-28001 to implement bank API.
2026-03-04 - Miguel Ortega: PR opened for API stub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2248 — waiting on schema review from Priya.
2026-03-05 - Decision log: Agreed to a 3-stage rollout (internal pilot → cross-team pilot → org opt-in) and to limit cross-team loans to 10% of bank at any time to prevent systemic depletion.
notes: Example numeric policy: Emergency tranche = min(5% of monthly budget, 10k errors); repayment = mitigation OR a repayment schedule that subtracts from next 3 months' available error budget at 40%/30%/30%
Abuse mitigation ideas: TTL on loans, cooldown windows, forced repayment on repeated over-use, and automatic model-variant fallback to maintain latency SLOs
Operational hooks: webhook on borrow/repay events, Slack approvals channel for manual overrides, and daily reconciliation job for the ledger
